To secure assets and ensure physical safety, immediately implement and review comprehensive emergency protocols for natural disasters, with particular emphasis on seismic preparedness in at-risk regions. Simultaneously, adjust financial portfolios to account for tech market volatility, strategically leveraging AI advancements while meticulously assessing new regulatory frameworks. Finally, secure and diversify essential supply chains, focusing on food and basic necessities to build resilience against economic shocks and potential resource scarcity.
